summary:
ASTRA – Astronaut Health Monitoring System

ASTRA is an interactive digital platform designed to support astronauts’ health during long-duration space missions. It combines daily health monitoring, educational resources, and preventive guidance in one accessible system.

The platform includes a daily questionnaire with 10 questions about sleep, energy, mood, stress, vision, physical activity, and other health indicators. Based on astronauts’ responses and previous records, ASTRA identifies potential warning signs and displays color-coded alerts to encourage timely medical attention.

It also features ASTRA Academy, an educational section explaining the five main hazards of human spaceflight (RIDGE), their effects on the human body, and preventive measures. Additionally, Health Guides provide information to help astronauts recognize changes in their health and understand when to contact medical personnel.

ASTRA addresses the challenge by combining health monitoring, education, and early risk awareness, helping astronauts take a more active role in protecting their wellbeing throughout space missions.
details:
ASTRA (Astronaut Health Monitoring System) is an interactive web platform designed to support astronauts in monitoring and understanding their health during long-duration space missions.

The platform collects daily health information through a questionnaire with 10 multiple-choice questions about sleep, energy levels, emotional wellbeing, stress, dizziness, vision, muscle discomfort, appetite, nausea, and physical activity. Based on the answers, ASTRA analyzes health indicators, identifies possible warning signs, and displays color-coded alerts to help astronauts recognize changes that may require attention.

The platform also includes a health history section with charts to track changes over time, ASTRA Academy, an educational space covering the five main hazards of human spaceflight (RIDGE), and Health Guides with information about prevention, possible symptoms, and appropriate actions.

ASTRA aims to help astronauts become more informed and proactive about their health, especially when access to medical assistance from Earth is limited. Its intended impact is to support early recognition of potential health concerns and encourage preventive care during space exploration.

The project is being developed as an interactive web application using Visual Studio Code, GitHub Copilot, React, TypeScript, and Vite. The prototype uses locally stored data and simulated astronaut records.

What makes ASTRA creative is the combination of daily health monitoring, scientific education, visual alerts, and preventive guidance in one accessible platform. The team considered the physical and psychological effects of spaceflight, the challenges of long-distance missions, the need for simple interfaces, and the importance of using scientifically supported information.

ASTRA is designed as an educational and monitoring prototype, not a replacement for professional medical evaluation or diagnosis.
